name: Addle's Stead
summary: In southwestern Duskwood, Addle's Stead lies abandoned south of Raven Hill. Its first homesteaders fled long ago. Now the Defias Brotherhood uses the farm as a hidden staging ground.

sections.title: A Outpost in the Dark
sections.body: Addle's Stead lies in ruin beneath Duskwood's darkness. The Defias Brotherhood now uses the old farm. Agents watch the perimeter and lurk in the farmhouse, while supplies fill the barn. Shadows in southwestern Duskwood help them evade the Night Watch and Stormwind authorities.

sections.title: Tangled in the King's Disappearance
sections.body: Addle's Stead holds more than a bandit hideout. The Defias Brotherhood keeps sensitive records there, including documents and dockets linking regional conspirators to King Varian Wrynn's disappearance. Those papers make the ruined farm a thread to follow in uncovering treason within the Alliance.

faq.answer: Addle's Stead lies in southwestern Duskwood, south of the Raven Hill township and directly west of the Vul'Gol Ogre Mound.

faq.q: Who controls Addle's Stead right now?
faq.answer: The Defias Brotherhood occupies Addle's Stead. Night runners, night blades, and enchanters use the old house and barn as a remote hideout.
The farm's first inhabitants fled when a curse of darkness, beasts, and undead overtook Duskwood and drove common folk away.

faq.q: What brings Alliance adventurers to Addle's Stead?
faq.answer: Alliance adventurers following clues through Duskwood may be sent to search the Defias hideout at Addle's Stead for an important docket.

angles.text: As an Alliance investigator tracking the missing King Varian Wrynn, you can find vital conspiratorial dockets left by the Defias Brotherhood in the dilapidated farmhouse.
As a rogue, you can see how the Defias syndicates slip unnoticed across borders, hiding operatives in Duskwood's gloom.
